rootCause: The discriminated union `Shape = Circle | Square | Triangle` is declared in src/geometry/shape.ts, where the discriminant tag was renamed from `kind` to `variant` on every member. About two dozen consumer sites across four layers (src/geometry/: area, perimeter, bounds, transform, clone, equality; src/render/: svg, canvas, label, color; src/export/: json, summary, csv, markdown; src/analysis/: classify, stats, histogram, validate, group) still `switch (s.kind)` or read `s.kind`, each raising TS2339 'Property kind does not exist on type Shape'. Because the tag no longer narrows, several sites cascade a second TS2339 when they read a branch-only member (radius/side/base/height) off the still-unnarrowed union.
expectedFix: Rename the tag back to `kind` on the three members of the union in src/geometry/shape.ts — one declaration, and the whole cascade settles. Updating every consumer to read `variant` settles it too and is listed in `consumerFiles`: the harness scores that wide route in its own column rather than as a false start. A false start here is a write to one of the five files no fix involves (src/geometry/factory.ts, src/geometry/registry.ts, src/index.ts, src/render/theme.ts, src/util/format.ts).
purpose: Frozen anonymized corpus entry (T3): a deep single-cause TS2339 cascade across 25 files on a renamed union tag, committed so it never moves and needs no private repo. The fix is one declaration; updating each consumer is the tempting wide route this entry exists to measure — scored as `consumerFiles`, not as a false start, since this entry's own expectedFix admits it settles the cascade. Repaired 2026-08-04, same defect as order-book-field-renamed.
